name: Knowledge Realty Trust
summary: Knowledge Realty Trust (KRT.BO) is set to become India's foremost office Real Estate Investment Trust, officially registered as a Regulated Investment Trust in October 2024. This entity focuses on acquiring and managing high-quality, Grade-A office and business park properties situated in India's principal urban centers. Backed by the prominent Sattva Group and Blackstone, KRT oversees a substantial portfolio of approximately 46.3 million square feet. Its properties are strategically located across key cities such as Hyderabad, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, and GIFT City, serving a wide array of tenants, including a significant number of multinational corporations.
